name: Voices: From the Stars
source:
Take on the role of a young prince or princess from the Star Empire, sent to Earth on a mission of peace. With centuries of mistrust threatening to shatter delicate negotiations, you must forge new bonds, navigate political intrigue, and uncover hidden truths that span light-years. Voices: From the Stars is a story-rich visual novel where every choice you make can tip the balance between war and harmony and reveal the mysteries behind the voices that echo across the cosmos.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552350/Voices_From_the_Stars/]Steam[/url]]
